title: Idealized microwave and millimeter-wave link comparison
hypothesis: At fixed declared antenna gains, free-space loss rises with frequency and distance; ideal bandwidth-based range resolution scales inversely with bandwidth.
differentiation: No novel RF method is established. These established baseline equations support reproducibility; literature/program overlap review and laboratory validation remain required.

link.assumption_reference: Unobstructed far-field, fixed gain, matched polarization, no interference; extra attenuation is a declared placeholder, not a weather model

sensing.assumption_reference: Ideal monostatic delay and bandwidth arithmetic in vacuum; no waveform, target or detector
